answer: The strongest single control I know for this is cross-chain event proof with BLS aggregate signature, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 704 pays 10560 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The shale test is the live device, the river test is the locked stake, and the sparrow test is the graded history no template can fake. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
